title: DispatchExecutionAttempt v2 metadata extension
description: Normative governance schema for the optional authoritative-result reference. This document does not select a serialization technology or implement a runtime model.

AuthoritativeResultId.description: Optional opaque ResultId. Its authority, authorization, scope, terminality, provenance, input match, and output validity MUST be verified by Skill Runtime; this value is not self-authenticating.

$comment: Absence of Metadata.AuthoritativeResultId preserves existing behavior. When present, it is propagated only as SkillInput.authoritative_result_id: str | None, never as the {statement} payload or CapabilityPolicyContext.
